text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Urara~♪ I wonder what kind of training~♪
we'll do today~♪

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan, perfect timing!
Care to taste-test some carrot sweets?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? What's that, what's that!?
I'll do it, totally down~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mnyaaa... So yummy~...
Hey lady~... This would totally sell, you know~?

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you!
Really, Urara-chan, you're always so full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ You really think so~?
Well then, I'm gonna sample even more!

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's a big help!
I'll go bring over the rest, then!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I really wish
Trainer could've tasted it too~.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wait, aaahhh!
Training's already supposed to have started!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
W-What should I dooo...?
I'm curious about the sweets too, though... ugh.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! I can just bring snacks to
Trainer later! I'm so smart!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hum-hum-hum~♪
I can't wait for the sweets to arrive~♪

Completely captivated by the sweets,
Haru Urara ended up slacking off on her training...
